data.title: Kitchen Science pH Lab
data.description: Discover how different everyday liquids change color with cabbage juice to unlock their secret pH numbers!

substances.name: Lemon Juice
substances.realWorldInfo: Lemon juice turns bright red with cabbage indicator because it is packed with citric acid, which gives it that yummy sour taste.

substances.name: Vinegar
substances.realWorldInfo: Vinegar is great for cooking and salad dressings, and people have used it for thousands of years as a natural helper around the house.

substances.name: Orange Juice
substances.realWorldInfo: Oranges are loaded with vitamin C, helping your body stay strong and healthy while tasting super sweet and tangy.

substances.name: Pure Water
substances.realWorldInfo: Pure water is totally neutral, meaning it is right in the middle of the scale and is the most important drink for living things.

substances.name: Baking Soda Solution
substances.realWorldInfo: Baking soda helps cakes rise nice and fluffy in the oven by creating tiny bubbles of gas when mixed with other ingredients.

substances.name: Hand Soap
substances.realWorldInfo: Hand soap helps trap dirt and germs in tiny bubbles so they easily wash right down the drain with water.

substances.name: Drain Cleaner
substances.realWorldInfo: Drain cleaner is a powerful helper used by grown-ups to clear out clogged sinks, and it is very high up on the opposite end of the scale from lemon juice.
